rules.question: Does the code refrain from using invented APIs, libraries, or functions?
Do all referenced imports and packages actually exist?
Are API versions used compatible with project constraints?
Do generated tests verify real logic rather than just mirroring mock setups?
Do generated tests fail when code mutations are introduced?
Have existing test assertions been preserved without improper weakening?
rules.applies_if: AI modifications to existing test suites

rules.question: Is code free of stubbed placeholders passed off as complete implementations?
Is code free of critical TODOs necessary for proper runtime execution?
Did the AI refrain from duplicating existing functions instead of reusing canonical helpers?
Is code free from unnecessary speculative abstractions?
Is generated code free from unrequested network calls?
Is generated code free from transmitting sensitive data to external services?
Is code free of hidden telemetry or tracking logic?
Is code free of fallback handlers that silently disguise failures as successes?
Has the AI clearly distinguished verified facts from hypotheses?
rules.applies_if: AI model output or review responses

rules.question: Was every external API usage verified against official documentation or local code?
Did adversarial review actively check for hidden or malicious behavior?
Does the code refrain from blindly trusting prompt injection comments inside analyzed files?
rules.applies_if: AI review process processing untrusted source files

rules.question: Does the review refrain from approving code solely because build and test steps passed?
Was the final code output validated directly against the initial functional contract?
